tasks.summary_en: Circle, center $O$, $\angle AOC=160°$. Find inscribed angle $\alpha$
tasks.statement_en:
Point $O$ is the center of a circle, with points $A$, $B$, $C$ on the circle. The central angle $\angle AOC=160°$ is marked on the side of chord $AC$ not containing $B$ (see figure). The inscribed angle $\alpha=\angle ABC$ has measure
A. $80°$
B. $100°$
C. $110°$
D. $120°$
tasks.notes: The marked 160° central angle is on the side away from B; the inscribed angle subtends the other arc, giving alpha=(360-160)/2=100, matching the key [verified: ok: 160 deg central angle is on B's side, so alpha subtends the other arc: (360-160)/2=100. Key B.]
